title: fix: explain when policy skips an advisor review
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Advisor reviews can be skipped when a Codex session restricts native tools, uses OpenClaw sandboxing, or assigns execution to a paired node. Previously these expected refusals were reported only as `fork_failed`, so operators could not tell that policy prevented the review.

## User Impact

Gateway warning logs now record `advisor: review skipped` with `tool_policy`, `sandbox`, or `exec_host_node`. No review ran in these cases. Unexpected fork failures remain `fork_failed`; cancellation handling stays intact. No configuration changes are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The catch in `extensions/advisor/index.ts:103` collapsed every non-timeout exception into `fork_failed`. The existing fork dispatcher in `src/gateway/server-plugin-subagent-runtime.ts:344` delegates Codex sessions to their harness; `extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.ts:325` correctly refuses unsupported native execution and restricted native tools. Those guards stay untouched.

This takes option (b), through Advisor's existing warning-log outcome contract. Step 0 found no advisor-specific per-agent/session exclusion: the plugin has global enablement and trigger settings, plus its existing hook permissions. Its documented contract uses the session's model, context, and credentials. The non-native fork in `src/agents/session-fork-run.ts:583` explicitly selects the OpenClaw runtime; it cannot preserve a Codex-owned model/auth connection automatically. `docs/concepts/agent-runtimes.md` also forbids replaying an executing harness's failures through another runtime. A fallback would require a separately authorized runtime/auth contract.

The SDK currently carries these refusals as plain `Error` values, without an exported policy classifier. The adapter matches only the three pinned Codex `/btw` refusal sentences, including the terminal period, and logs fixed reason codes. This avoids a private cross-plugin import or new SDK export. If those sentences change, classification must be updated with the owning guard tests; an unrecognized error remains an unexpected failure. No tools, authority, runtime, or credentials are widened.

## Evidence

The advisor fork-boundary regression uses fixed refusal fixtures from the Codex side-question contract and checks the actual scheduled review's warning outcome. On unchanged production code, the three policy cases failed because they logged `fork_failed`; with the fix, all three log distinct skips. The unexpected-error control passes in both versions. This is boundary-fixture proof, not a live Codex/provider call or production validation.

- Red: `pnpm test extensions/advisor/index.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` — `Tests 3 failed | 11 passed (14)`; expected `review skipped`, received `review failed ... fork_failed`. Cold run wall time: 104.38s.
- Green: advisor suite `Tests 14 passed (14)`, 7.18s file wall time; all six requested files passed, 89 tests, 174.89s total wall time. Exact-head [CI run 44215122212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44215122212) succeeded without retries. Shared CI job wall times: extension config checks 136s; compact-small-1 231s (shared job timings, not isolated advisor test time).
- Green command: `pnpm test extensions/advisor/index.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.fork.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.model-selection.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.app-consent.test.ts src/agents/agent-tools.prefix-stability.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`.
- Targeted Oxlint, formatting, plugin reference regeneration, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Targeted typecheck (`node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p extensions/advisor/tsconfig.json --incremental`) and `pnpm build` passed. The initial typecheck lacked unbuilt SDK declarations; it passed after generation. Build completed in 3m 27.3s and exited 0, with advisory UI asset-budget violations (largest CSS gzip 58,957/58,315 B; chat boot JS 21/20 requests and 1,331,328/1,331,081 B gzip); this patch changes no UI source.
- Codex autoreview against base `4dbd70ff`: scoped-clean at P0–P2, no actionable findings; full local candidate and fork/runtime owners supplied as context.

The author simplification pass kept the fix inside the existing advisor catch: +20 production lines, +20 test lines, +6 documentation lines, no helper, state, or new fork owner. The lane's test allowance is raised to exactly 20 lines in `config/test-lines-allocations/advisor-policy-skip.txt` to retain the three policy cases and unexpected-error control without deleting unrelated coverage.
